signin.title: Connect your iCloud
signin.lede: Your iCloud, kept on this computer.
signin.passwordAssurance: Your password never leaves this computer.
signin.independence: Skykeep is independent and not made by Apple.
signin.accountOrPasswordIncorrect: Apple Account or password is incorrect. Check both and try again.
signin.privacyDetail1Text: Your password never leaves this computer. Skykeep proves you know it without sending it, and keeps your session in your system keyring. No Skykeep account and no analytics: your iCloud travels only between this computer and Apple.
signin.privacyDetail2Text: An app-specific password opens only mail, contacts and calendars to other apps. Notes, Reminders, Drive and Photos open to a full sign-in with your two-factor code, the same one icloud.com uses.
signin.privacyDetail3Text: Managed Apple Accounts from a school or workplace aren’t supported yet.
signin.privacyDetail4TextBefore: Your calendar, reminders, notes, contacts and Drive live on this computer in
signin.privacyDetail4TextAfter: , so everything opens instantly and works offline.
signin.privacyDetail5Text: Health, Messages, Keychain and your other end-to-end encrypted data stay protected on your Apple devices, just as Apple designed.
signin.privacyDetail6Text: Made by an independent developer, not affiliated with Apple. It uses the web services icloud.com uses, which Apple can change at any time.

codeEntry.title: Two-Factor Authentication
codeEntry.securityKeyTitle: This account uses a security key
codeEntry.securityKeyLede: Your Apple Account signs in with a security key. Skykeep can't sign in with security keys yet, so it can't finish signing in to this account.
codeEntry.ledeLapse: Apple wants a code before it trusts this computer again.
codeEntry.ledeCalling: Apple is calling {number} with a code.
codeEntry.ledeDevices: Apple sent a code to your devices.
codeEntry.ledeNowhere: Apple has nowhere to send a code for this account.
codeEntry.ledeOnlyCalls: No device is reachable, but Apple can call you with a code.
codeEntry.ledeCanText: No device is reachable, but a code can be texted to you.
codeEntry.tooManyCodes: Apple is limiting new codes. Wait a few minutes before asking again.
codeEntry.nowhereHelp: This account has no device or number to send to. Use a device you're still signed in on, or add a number at account.apple.com.
codeEntry.allowHelp: The code appears once you tap Allow on your iPhone.
codeEntry.offlineTip: No prompt? On iPhone, turn on Airplane Mode, then open Settings → your name → Sign-In & Security. iOS offers a code there only while offline.
codeEntry.staySignedInAssurance: You'll stay signed in on this computer.

library.agreeTermsTitle: Agree to the new iCloud terms
library.agreeTermsDesc: Apple has updated the iCloud Terms and Conditions. Once you agree to them, your iCloud opens here.
library.finishSetupDesc: Apple needs one more step on your Apple Account before your iCloud opens here.
library.signinBrowserAction: Sign in at {host} in your browser and follow what it asks{agreeSuffix}. Then click Try Again.
library.webAccessOffTitle: Your iCloud data is kept off the web
library.webAccessOffDesc1: Your Apple Account uses Advanced Data Protection with “Access iCloud Data on the Web” turned off, so Apple doesn’t let any app outside your devices — Skykeep included — read your iCloud.
library.webAccessOffDesc2: To use Skykeep, turn it on: on your iPhone, open Settings, tap your name, then iCloud, and turn on Access iCloud Data on the Web. Then sign in to Skykeep again.
library.emptyServices: Apple hasn’t offered Reminders, Notes, iCloud Drive, Calendar or Contacts to this account yet.
